ntu-ab0301.rationale: Course teaches anti-bribery/corruption law, ESG governance, and designing compliance programs for risk management, matching the compliance analyst's law/regulatory knowledge base.

ntu-ab1301.rationale: Foundational business law (contracts, agency, business organisations, torts) builds the legal literacy compliance analysts need to interpret regulatory requirements.

ntu-ab5101.rationale: Course is a direct, in-depth treatment of business valuation approaches, IVSC standards, and discounts/premiums, squarely matching the financial analyst's core valuation-modeling skill.

matchedSkills: Working with law enforcement and legal counsel
ntu-ab5102.rationale: Course explicitly teaches fraud investigation methodology, IT forensics, interviewing/interrogation, and the role of an expert witness, directly matching forensic accountant duties.
Analysis of financial-statement and cash fraud schemes gives auditors relevant fraud-detection grounding, though the course is forensics-focused rather than audit-testing focused.

ntu-ac3104.rationale: Course teaches ERM frameworks for identifying/assessing/managing risk plus audit analytics, directly building risk-based audit scoping capability.
ERM and sustainability-assurance frameworks overlap with compliance analysts' need to evaluate organizational risk and regulatory exposure.
Hands-on data analytics/data-mining for business and fraud risk assessment and audit analytics gives relevant fraud-detection technique exposure.

ntu-ac3105.rationale: Course teaches preparing/interpreting sustainability reports against mandatory ESG standards (TCFD, GRI, IR, SASB, ISSB), matching the financial accountant's reporting-standards-conformance skill.
